bb.notes: A RegionGuard command, not a NeoEssentials one. Requires the base node regionguard.command plus owner or member status of a regular region (not __global__) under the player. The named player must be online and in the same region; an owner/member of that region stays put, while a guest is immediately teleported to the configured NeoEssentials spawn (if set) or the vanilla spawn and gets a message about being sent back. The warmup and messages of the regular /spawn are not used. In /help the command description is shown in Russian ("Send a guest of the current claim back to spawn").

help.notes: Before registering it removes the vanilla help and ? nodes via reflection. One word argument: a plain number ≥ 1 is a page number (10 commands each), otherwise a search by name/description in the CommandRegistry catalog. A second page exists only for /help <command> <page>; /? has none. The list is filtered by the actual node from CommandPermissionRegistry; the console and holders of neoessentials.admin / neoessentials.* see everything. The description is looked up first by the full syntax without placeholders (for example, cmd.rg.flag.clear.description), then by the root (cmd.bb.description); so individual /rg branches show different Russian descriptions. A player can type the root of any NeoEssentials command or alias in any case (/HOME, /Home, /home); the case of arguments and subcommands is not changed. Node — neoessentials.help (not neoessentials.?).

?.notes: Alias of /help: the same requires (neoessentials.help, the console passes), the same executeHelp. No <command> <page> branch. The catalog shows the node as neoessentials.? — a registry convention; the check uses neoessentials.help.

anvil.notes: Player only (console — player_only). A virtual menu with stillValid=true, no physical block. The root .requires is instanceof ServerPlayer. The neoessentials.anvil permission is checked by PermissionValidator (a console with OP 2 never gets here anyway because of requires). Repair XP is charged as with a normal anvil.

crafting.notes: Player only (console — player_only). A virtual menu with stillValid=true, no physical block. Permission neoessentials.crafting via PermissionValidator. The craft and workbench aliases are registered by the same method if commands.crafting is on.

craft.notes: Alias of /crafting. Permission neoessentials.crafting, not neoessentials.craft. Disabled by the commands.crafting key; there is no separate commands.craft.

workbench.notes: Alias of /crafting. Permission neoessentials.crafting. Declared in the catalog with this node explicitly.

grindstone.notes: Player only (console — player_only). A virtual menu with stillValid=true, no physical block. Permission neoessentials.grindstone.

stonecutting.notes: Player only (console — player_only). A virtual menu with stillValid=true, no physical block. Permission neoessentials.stonecutting. The stonecut literal is also registered (it is not in the /help catalog — not a separate claimed command).

seen.notes: Without an argument the root .executes replies with usage and returns 0. Looks up online by exact name, otherwise case-insensitive in seen_data.json (UUID → activity). Console: PermissionValidator, needs source.hasPermission(2). File config/neoessentials/seen_data.json.

near.notes: Player only. Radius Integer 1–500, default 100. Same dimension; vanish is checked pairwise via canViewerSeeVanishedPlayer. The /tp click in the hint only with neoessentials.teleport.tp. Does not work from the console.

nearby.notes: A separate tree, the same 1–500 / 100. The check is neoessentials.near, not neoessentials.nearby. Enabled by the commands.nearby key independently of commands.near.

ping.notes: Without an argument — your own ping (the console gets player=null from PermissionValidator.success() and goes into latency() — do not call it without a target). Another player: EntityArgument.player() (online only) and neoessentials.ping.others (true by default). Quality — English strings Excellent…Terrible, not from lang.

pong.notes: Only a /help catalog entry (registerCommand in NeoEssentials.java). There is no Commands.literal("pong") in the sources — the command will not appear in Brigadier completion, and /pong does nothing. See /ping.

playtime.notes: Target — word + online name (getPlayerByName). Counter: Stats.PLAY_TIME plus the current session's milliseconds from sessionStart (set in onPlayerJoin). Console without a target — player_only. Another player — neoessentials.playtime.others.

whois.notes: No root .executes. Two branches: EntityArgument.player() (online) and word playername. The offline branch calls getOfflinePlayerSeenInfo, which always returns Optional.empty() — an offline name gives player_not_found. UUID/coordinates/IP only with neoessentials.whois.detailed. The whois node is false by default. Not to be confused with /info.

realname.notes: Without an argument — usage. Searches online: exact name, then nickname without &-codes, then contains. Multiple matches print a list (up to 10). Does not search offline. Permission neoessentials.realname.

list.notes: No arguments. With vanish, hidden players are not shown without neoessentials.vanish.see. With LuckPerms loaded — lines by primary group (descending weight, default always at the bottom); otherwise a single grey "Players:". The console passes PermissionValidator with OP 2.

motd.syntax: /motd | /motd set <message> | /motd clear | /motd reload | /motd broadcast | /motd profile list | /motd profile create <name> <message> | /motd profile delete <name> | /motd profile switch <name> | /motd profile info [name] | /motd rotation enable <intervalMinutes> | /motd rotation disable | /motd rotation next
motd.notes: The root is gated by allowsAny: neoessentials.motd / motd.set / motd.broadcast / motd.reload / motd.profile / motd.rotation — any one is enough to see the tree. Bare /motd still checks neoessentials.motd internally. set/clear — motd.set; reload — motd.reload; broadcast — motd.broadcast (sends only to players with motd); the profile branch — motd.profile; rotation — motd.rotation (interval Integer 1–10080). set and create: greedyString, & → §, placeholders {player}/{online}/{max}/{time} and PlaceholderAPI.

compass.notes: Without a target — player only, neoessentials.compass. With a target EntityArgument.player() and compass.others; the console can view another player's. Shows cardinal directions, coordinates, biome, distance to spawn. An extra bearing literal is registered but is not in the /help catalog.

getpos.notes: Without a target — player, neoessentials.getpos. With a target — getpos.others. Exact and block coordinates, light, the block underfoot, the Nether/Overworld equivalent. An extra pos literal exists in the tree but not in the catalog.

depth.notes: The root .requires is instanceof ServerPlayer: the console cannot run even /depth <player>. Your own — neoessentials.depth; another player's EntityArgument.player() — depth.others. Sea level Y=63, bedrock Y=−64. Layer descriptions are hardcoded in English (Deepslate Level, Nether Floor…).

info.notes: Not an alias of /whois, despite the catalog description. Prints a header + the active MOTD (only {player}/{name}) + a footer with a link to /rules. Permission neoessentials.info (default true). The console passes (p == null).

fly.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. The order is not [on|off] [player]: the target comes first, or bare on/off for yourself. Another player — neoessentials.fly.others on the target branch. Without on/off it inverts mayfly; turning off resets flying and fallDistance. The enabled state is saved by UUID and restored after login if the player still has neoessentials.fly.

god.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. Enabling also fully heals and sets hunger to 20, clears the target from nearby mobs and prevents mobs from picking them as a new target. Another player — god.others. The enabled state is saved by UUID and restored after login if the player still has neoessentials.god.

heal.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. Full HP, hunger 20, saturation 20, removeAllEffects. Does not heal the dead (heal.dead). Another player — heal.others.

feed.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. Only hunger and saturation 20; effects are not touched. Another player — feed.others.

speed.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. Float 0–10 → Minecraft 0.0–1.0 (cap 1.0). Bare /speed <n> checks whether the target is flying right now (abilities.flying), not mayfly. Walk — MOVEMENT_SPEED; fly — Abilities.flyingSpeed + onUpdateAbilities. Another player — speed.others.

ext.notes: requires: p == null || node — the console and command blocks pass without OP. Target — word, online only via getPlayerByName. clearFire(). Another player — ext.others.

burn.notes: The target is required. Seconds Integer 1–600, default 10. Sets remainingFireTicks = seconds×20. There is no separate burn.others — neoessentials.burn is enough. The console passes.

give.notes: Target and item are required. item — word (no NBT/components); resolved by WorthManager.resolveItem: namespace:path, otherwise minecraft:path, otherwise an exact path from any mod, otherwise contains. amount Integer 1–3456, default 1; stacks are split by maxStack, the excess drops. Overrides vanilla /give. Does not overlap with /crate key give — that is a /crate subcommand.

more.notes: Player only, main hand. Without amount — maxStackSize; otherwise Integer 1–3456 (can exceed the max stack size). Empty hand — no_item. Console: the tree is visible (p == null), execute — player_only.

hat.notes: Player only. Swaps the main hand and armor slot 3 (helmet), even if the item is "not a helmet". Empty hand — no_item.

exp.notes: The order is amount then target, not the other way round. Bare /exp and show — your own XP (console without a target — player_only). set: neoessentials.exp.set, amount ≥ 0 (first zeroes levels/points, then giveExperiencePoints). give: exp.give, amount ≥ 1. Another player's set/give — exp.set.others / exp.give.others. Target online only.

xp.notes: A trimmed alias of /exp: the same permissions neoessentials.exp / exp.set / exp.give, but no show and no [target] on set/give — you cannot give another player XP with this command. Vanilla /xp is overridden.

sudo.notes: The * and ** literals are separate (word() does not consume "*"). * — everyone except the sender; ** — everyone including. command — greedyString; the c: prefix sends chat via ServerChatEvent (formatter/mute/anti-spam), otherwise performPrefixedCommand without the leading /. You cannot target yourself by name (sudo.self); exempt players are silently skipped in bulk and block a single target if the sender is a player (the console bypasses exempt).

gamemode.notes: Mode names are literals, not word. The numbers 0–3 = survival/creative/adventure/spectator and do not accept [target]. Another player — gamemode.others. Console without a target — player_only. Overrides vanilla /gamemode. Target — online word.

gms.notes: Survival shortcut. Enabled by commands.gamemode. Your own — neoessentials.gamemode, another player's EntityArgument.player() — gamemode.others. Already in that mode — already_in_mode. Console without a target — player_only.

gmc.notes: Creative shortcut. The same permission and target scheme as /gms.

gma.notes: Adventure shortcut. The same permission and target scheme as /gms.

gmsp.notes: Spectator shortcut. The same permission and target scheme as /gms.

suicide.notes: Player only. The first call opens a 10 s window; confirm kills with DamageTypes.GENERIC_KILL (not PvP). A 30 s cooldown after success. Creative/Spectator — invalid_gamemode. Not an alias of vanilla /kill.

killme.notes: Alias of /suicide, permission neoessentials.suicide. Enabled by commands.suicide.

ptime.notes: A client-side ClientboundSetTimePacket; does not change server time. Bare — show. reset removes it; <time> — sunrise/day/morning/noon/afternoon/sunset/night/dusk/midnight or ticks; "reset" as a word also gives −1. Another player — ptime.others. The map is in memory; onPlayerQuit erases it.

pweather.notes: Client-side RAIN/THUNDER_LEVEL_CHANGE. clear and rain are synonyms of sun/storm, but without the [target] branch. Another player — pweather.others. State is in memory and resets on quit. There is no separate thunder.

time.notes: Bare — the current ticks of the source's world. set/add and the shorthand value require neoessentials.time.set. Names: sunrise=23000, day/morning=1000, noon=6000, afternoon=9000, sunset=12000, night/dusk=13000, midnight=18000, or a Long. Writes setDayTime to ALL dimensions. Overrides vanilla /time.

day.notes: Sets 1000 in all worlds. Permission neoessentials.time.set, not neoessentials.time.

night.notes: Sets 13000 in all worlds. Permission neoessentials.time.set.

weather.notes: duration Integer 1–1000000 seconds; 0 in code → 6000 ticks (5 min). clear=sun, rain=storm. Only dimensions with hasSkyLight (Nether/End are skipped). Overrides vanilla /weather.

sun.notes: Shortcut for /weather sun without a duration, permission neoessentials.weather.

storm.notes: Shortcut for /weather storm without a duration, permission neoessentials.weather.

thunder.notes: Shortcut for /weather thunder without a duration, permission neoessentials.weather.

broadcast.notes: greedyString. PlaceholderAPI placeholders from the sender (console — without a player). Prefix §6[Broadcast] §f, colour codes. Sent to all players and to the server's system chat — there is no separate "sent to N". The console passes.

n.notes: Automatically puts the red prefix §c[Объявление] §7>> §r ("Announcement") before the text. The argument is greedyString; & colour codes and PlaceholderAPI placeholders from the sender are supported, so you can style the text in any colour. Access: neoessentials.notice or OP level 2; the console passes too. The message is sent directly as a system message and does not go through the regular chat handlers.

broadcastworld.notes: Only players in the current src.getLevel() (for the console that is usually the overworld). Prefix §6[World] §e. PlaceholderAPI placeholders.

gc.notes: JVM uptime, TPS from getAverageTickTimeNanos (cap 20), used/total/max MB, the total of loaded chunks. The console passes.

kill.notes: The target is required — you cannot kill yourself without a name (unlike vanilla /kill). Online players only. exempt plus no kill.force on a player sender blocks it; the console bypasses exempt. genericKill. Overrides vanilla /kill (entities/selectors no longer work).

world.notes: Bare — a list of dimension().location(). Teleports to the dimension's shared spawn; path or full id, case-insensitive. Another player — world.others. Console without a target — player_only.

spawner.notes: Player only, a 6-block ray, the block must be a SPAWNER. Besides neoessentials.spawner you need spawner.<mob> or spawner.*. An id without ":" → minecraft:. Changes setEntityId; no drops.

recipe.notes: Player only. Without item — the item in the main hand. Otherwise word → minecraft:path. awardRecipes for all recipes with that result. Overrides vanilla /recipe (the give/take branches no longer exist).

backup.notes: save(null, true, false) across all levels, then a ProcessBuilder from commands.backupCommand (an empty string / "save-all" — save only). The command is split by spaces, inheritIO, does not wait for completion. Permission neoessentials.backup.

unlimited.notes: Bare and list print the set of ids. clear removes everything. <item> toggles an id (minecraft: prefix, or hand — the id from the sender's hand). Another player — unlimited.others. The set is in memory; onPlayerQuit erases it. Stack refilling is done by the item-use handler.

effect.notes: The target is required (online word). duration 1–1000000 s, default 30; amplifier 0–255, default 0. Effect — path or namespace:path. Overrides vanilla /effect. The console passes.

spawnmob.notes: amount Integer 1–100, default 1. Without target — at the sender's feet (console — player_only). Another player — spawnmob.others. finalizeSpawn COMMAND. An id without ":" → minecraft:.

mob.notes: Alias of /spawnmob without the [target] branch — you cannot spawn at another player with this command. Permission neoessentials.spawnmob.

invsee.notes: The target EntityArgument.player() is required. The console passes requires, but execute uses getPlayerOrException (a player is needed). Audit — neoessentials/inventory_audit.log. With `neoessentials.invsee` a read-only window opens (mayPickup/mayPlace=false); with `neoessentials.invsee.edit` — the editable live inventory and a "one editor per target" lock. The `.edit` node also grants access to the command itself and takes precedence over viewing. You cannot view your own inventory (invsee.self). Enabled by commands.invsee.

inv.notes: Alias of /invsee, not a redirect: its own requires. The mode is determined the same way: `neoessentials.invsee` — view, `neoessentials.invsee.edit` — edit.

enderchest.notes: Only another/specified player's EC; there is no own-EC variant without a target. Unlike invsee, it does not forbid yourself — /ec <your name> opens it. Permission neoessentials.enderchest.

enderchestedit.notes: The target's live EC, single-editor lock. Permission neoessentials.enderchest.edit, key commands.enderchestedit.

fireball.notes: Player only. Defaults: type=fireball, speed=2.0, no ride. Suggested types: fireball, small, large, arrow, skull, egg, snowball, expbottle, dragon, trident, windcharge. speed Double 0–10. ride is a literal, permission fireball.ride. After the root fireball, execute additionally requires fireball.<type> or fireball.* — for bare /fireball that is fireball.fireball (no such node in the registry) or fireball.*.

tree.notes: Player only, a 20-block ray, plants on the block above the hit. Types: oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia, darkoak, mangrove, cherry, azalea, bigoak, mega_spruce, mega_jungle. Permission neoessentials.tree.

bigtree.notes: Calls the same handler with type=bigoak (fancy_oak). Permission neoessentials.tree.

break.notes: Player only, a 20-block ray, destroyBlock without drops. Bedrock — only with neoessentials.break.bedrock. Console: the tree is visible, execute — player_only.

ice.notes: setTicksFrozen(getTicksRequiredToFreeze()+1) — the powder snow mechanic, not an ice block. Your own — neoessentials.ice; another online word — ice.others. Console without a target — player_only.

bottom.notes: Player only. Looks for the lowest solid block with two air above it between minBuildHeight and the current Y, records back via MiscTeleportManager. No safe place — no_safe.

lightning.notes: Without a target — a strike at the point of a 100-block ray (a player is needed). With a target — at an online player's feet, permission lightning.others. Console without a target — player_only.

remove.notes: Player only. type: all, items, drops, mobs, animals, monsters, arrows, xp, paintings, boats, minecarts, tnt. Radius Integer 1–10000, default 200. Does not touch players. An unknown type matches 0 removals. Not to be confused with /rules remove.

nuke.notes: Not entity removal. Without a target — everyone online; with a target — one name. Above each, a 5×5 grid of PrimedTnt (step 5, −10..10) at maxBuildHeight, fuse 80 ticks. Permission neoessentials.nuke. The console without a target bombs everyone.

firework.notes: No root .executes — bare /firework does not run. You need a rocket in your main hand. power Integer 0–127; fire 1–50 and a separate neoessentials.firework.fire; color — greedyString: hex[,hex] and optionally fade:/shape (star, large, creeper, burst) / trail|twinkle|flicker. Player only.

fw.notes: Only a /help catalog entry. There is no Commands.literal("fw") — the alias does not work. Use /firework.

antioch.notes: Player only. A 20-block ray, PrimedTnt fuse 80. Any greedy argument adds two server-wide Holy Hand Grenade lines; TNT spawns either way. Permission neoessentials.antioch.

kittycannon.notes: Player only. A kitten (age −24000) with a look-direction×2 impulse; after 20 ticks discard + explode power 0, ExplosionInteraction.NONE — no block damage. Permission neoessentials.kittycannon.

beezooka.notes: Player only. amount Integer 1–20, default 1. Bees with persistent anger of 400–800 ticks. Permission neoessentials.beezooka.

rest.notes: Not a vote to skip the night. resetStat(TIME_SINCE_REST) — resets the phantom timer. Your own — neoessentials.rest (default true); another player — rest.others. Console without a target — player_only.

potion.notes: Not /effect: edits the POTION_CONTENTS of the item in hand (potion / splash / lingering / tipped_arrow). duration 1–1000000 s default 30; amplifier 0–255 default 0. No root .executes. Player only. Permission neoessentials.potion.

rtoggle.notes: Where /r replies: enabled (default) — to the last person you messaged; disabled — to the last person who messaged you. Another player — rtoggle.others. Console without a target — player_only. State is in process memory.

rules.syntax: /rules | /rules <page> | /rules add <rule> | /rules remove <number> | /rules edit <number> <newText> | /rules insert <number> <rule> | /rules clear | /rules reload
rules.notes: Viewing — neoessentials.rules (default true), 10 lines each, page Integer ≥ 1. Admin branches — rules.admin. add/edit/insert: greedyString, & → §. Numbering starts at 1. File config/neoessentials/rules_data.json; the legacy rules.json migrates by itself. PermissionValidator (console = OP 2).

rg.syntax: /rg define <id> | /rg claim <id> | /rg redefine <id> | /rg remove <id> | /rg delete <id> | /rg list | /rg tp <id> | /rg clearowners <id> | /rg clearmembers <id> | /rg info [id] | /rg addowner <id> <player> | /rg addmember <id> <player> | /rg delowner <id> <player> | /rg delmember <id> <player> | /rg flag <id> list | /rg flag <id> <flag> <value> | /rg flag <id> clear <flag> [value]
rg.notes: helpCatalogOnly: NeoEssentials does not build Brigadier for /rg. The tree belongs to the "regionguard" mod; these 17 lines, as well as /bb <player>, appear in /help only if ModList.isLoaded("regionguard") at startup. In /help each /rg branch gets its own translated description (for example define, list and flag clear), not a shared text for the /rg root. Without the mod, /rg and /bb are not in the catalog and NE does not register them. Permissions and behaviour belong to RegionGuard, not to neoessentials.rg nodes.

examples.title: Switch the mode for yourself and someone else with shortcuts
examples.goal: Check that /gms and /gmc go into the same tree as the full /gamemode, and that someone else's mode is gated by a separate node.
examples.result: /gms without a target sets Survival for the sender (needs neoessentials.gamemode; the console gets player_only). /gmc Steve requires gamemode.others and an online EntityArgument player — offline gives "player not found". /gamemode spectator is a full literal, not a number. /gamemode 1 Steve does not parse: the 0–3 branches do not accept [target]; 1 is for yourself only. If you are already in that mode, the shortcuts reply already_in_mode.

examples.title: Portable GUIs without a block
examples.goal: Open a crafting table and an anvil in the field, and make sure the console cannot do it.
examples.result: workbench and craft are one /crafting handler (permission neoessentials.crafting, key commands.crafting). anvil / grindstone / stonecutter are separate commands and keys. The menus are virtual (stillValid is always true); XP on the anvil is charged as usual. From the console all five reply player_only (anvil also has a root requires ServerPlayer).

examples.title: An announcement to the whole server and to your world only
examples.goal: Tell /broadcast from /broadcastworld and see that placeholders are taken from the sender.
examples.result: /broadcast and /bc send the line §6[Broadcast] §f… to everyone online and to the server's system chat — there is no separate "sent to N"; you see your own message as a recipient. {online} is resolved by PlaceholderAPI. /broadcastworld marks it §6[World] §e and filters by src.getLevel(): a player in the Nether will not see an announcement from the Overworld; the console usually broadcasts to the overworld.

examples.title: Joke projectiles
examples.goal: Check that /antioch, /kittycannon and /beezooka require a player and do not work from the console.
examples.result: Look at a block (20-block ray). /antioch places TNT with an 80-tick fuse; any tail like holy additionally broadcasts two Holy Hand Grenade lines. /kittycannon launches a kitten; a second later the entity vanishes with a power-0 explosion (blocks are intact). /beezooka 3 — three angry bees (limit 20). The console gets player_only for all three.

examples.title: RegionGuard in help, not in NeoEssentials
examples.goal: Understand why /rg is sometimes in /help and sometimes not, and who actually runs the command.
examples.result: If the regionguard mod is loaded, /help rg shows 17 syntaxes from the catalog (define, claim, flag…). /rg list itself is executed by RegionGuard: NeoEssentials only called registerCommand("rg …") at startup. Without regionguard these lines are not in /help, and /rg list is either an unknown command or another mod's tree — NeoEssentials does not create it.

edgeCases.title: OP and permission nodes — three different checks
edgeCases.body:
Most trees in PlayerState/ServerAdmin/Fun/Utility use `.requires(p == null || PermissionAPI.hasPermission(...))`. The console, command blocks and functions always pass. For a player, PermissionAPI with `opsBypassPermissions: true` (the default in config.json) returns true for any OP, even without the node. With `permissions.requireExplicitGrant: true` (shipped) the registry default does not grant access by itself — a non-OP needs an explicit grant.

Commands on PermissionValidator (seen, ping, depth, anvil, crafting, rules, all of /motd, suicide, list, near, whois, compass, getpos, gamemode shortcuts) require `source.hasPermission(2)` for a non-player — a command block without OP 2 is refused. A player still needs the node if they are not OP and the bypass is off.

The /gms shortcuts and the full /gamemode differ: the shortcuts use PermissionValidator, /gamemode uses PermissionAPI with `p == null`.
edgeCases.fix: Grant nodes to non-OPs explicitly. To stop OPs getting /give and /nuke "for free", set `opsBypassPermissions: false` and give nodes to groups. Restrict command blocks with /sudo and /nuke via vanilla OP and access to the blocks.

edgeCases.title: Console vs player
edgeCases.body:
The GUIs (anvil, crafting, grindstone, stonecutting), /hat, /more, /break, /tree, /fireball, /spawner, /recipe, /remove, /bottom, /suicide and all fun commands require a ServerPlayer in execute. /depth and /anvil additionally set `.requires(instanceof ServerPlayer)` — the console does not even reach the target.

Another online name is accepted by fly/god/heal/give/kill/effect: /give Steve diamond 64 works from the console. /ping and /compass without a name cannot be used from the console (your own ping/compass).

/nuke without an argument from the console bombs everyone online. /list and /gc work from the console with OP 2 (Validator) or right away (PermissionAPI).
edgeCases.fix: From the console always specify a name where there is [player]/[target]. Do not leave a command block with a bare /nuke.

edgeCases.title: /give does not collide with crates and breaks vanilla /give
edgeCases.body:
Crate keys are given with `/crate key give <player> <crate> <amount>` — a different literal, a different module. There is no overlap with `/give`.

NeoEssentials registers its own `/give <target> <item> [amount]`: item is a word without components/NBT, amount 1–3456. Vanilla `/give <targets> <item>` with `@a` selectors, count via component and data components in square brackets after the item is no longer parsed once the mod registers — Brigadier keeps the mod's node.

Item resolution — WorthManager: `minecraft:diamond`, `diamond` or a path fragment (`copper` takes the first id whose path contains "copper").
edgeCases.fix: Do vanilla giving with NBT via `/minecraft:give`. For crates — only `/crate key give`. Do not rely on the "first diamond_ore vs diamond" order in fuzzy contains.

edgeCases.title: /fly and /god state is saved; the other personal toggles are not
edgeCases.body: Enabled /fly and /god are written to the DataStore collection `player_command_states` by UUID and restored on the next login. Restoring requires the player to still have the corresponding neoessentials.fly or neoessentials.god permission; if the permission is revoked, the saved flag is deleted. `playerTimes`, `playerWeather` and `unlimitedItems` remain in-memory maps and are cleared on quit.
edgeCases.fix: For permanent flight or protection enable /fly or /god once. For client-side time, weather and unlimited use a command block, a script or the panel after login.

edgeCases.title: /xp is not /exp, /mob is not /spawnmob
edgeCases.body: `/exp` supports show/set/give and [target] on set/give. `/xp` — only bare, set <amount> and give <amount> for yourself. `/spawnmob <mob> [amount] [target]` spawns at another player; `/mob` stops at amount. Both aliases are labelled as full commands in the catalog, but the tree is shorter.
edgeCases.fix: For another player's XP and mobs at another player use the canonical /exp and /spawnmob.

knownIssues.title: /pong and /fw are in /help but not in Brigadier
knownIssues.body: NeoEssentials.java calls `registerCommand("pong")` and `registerCommand("fw")`, so the lines end up in the HelpCommand catalog. Neither PingCommand nor FunCommands creates `Commands.literal("pong")` / `literal("fw")`. Completion and parsing follow the tree: /pong and /fw are unknown commands (or vanilla/another mod, if someone else took them).
knownIssues.fix: Ping — /ping. Firework — /firework clear|power|fire|color. Do not promise players aliases from /help until the literals appear in the source.

knownIssues.title: /info is labelled as a whois alias in the catalog but does something else
knownIssues.body: `registerCommand("info", "Get player information (alias)")` describes whois, but WhoisCommand does not register an info literal. FunCommands attaches /info to printing the MOTD + a footer about /rules. Permission neoessentials.info, no arguments — /info Steve does not work as whois.
knownIssues.fix: Player data — only /whois <player>. Treat /info as a short MOTD.

knownIssues.title: /compass prints the card twice
knownIssues.body: In the no-target branch CompassCommand calls `showCompassInfo(...)` twice in a row. The player sees a duplicated "facing / coordinates / biome" block. The [player] branch is called once.
knownIssues.fix: Until it is fixed, read the first card. /compass <player> for someone else has no duplicate.

knownIssues.title: /whois does not show offline players
knownIssues.body: The word branch calls `showOfflinePlayerInfo` → `getOfflinePlayerSeenInfo`, which always returns `Optional.empty()` (an "integrate with SeenCommand" stub). Even with neoessentials.whois.detailed an offline name ends in player_not_found. Online — EntityArgument.player() — works.
knownIssues.fix: Check offline status with /seen <player> (seen_data.json). /whois only for those currently in the world.

knownIssues.title: Bare /fireball requires the nonexistent node fireball.fireball
knownIssues.body: The root requires checks neoessentials.fireball. executeFireball for the default type `"fireball"` additionally requires `neoessentials.fireball.fireball` or `neoessentials.fireball.*`. There is no fireball.fireball node in PermissionRegistry. A player with only fireball (and no OP bypass) gets no_perm_type. The `trident` suggestion is in PROJECTILE_TYPES but not in the switch — a large fireball spawns.
knownIssues.fix: Grant neoessentials.fireball.* (or OP with opsBypassPermissions). For the trident do not expect a separate entity.

knownIssues.title: /recipe, /give, /kill, /xp, /effect override vanilla
knownIssues.body: The mod registers the same literals after vanilla. Lost: `/recipe give`, `/give` with selectors and components, `/kill @e`, full `/xp add/query`, vanilla `/effect`. The mod removes /help via reflection and installs its own. This is not a parsing failure — the last tree wins.
knownIssues.fix: Vanilla parsing — with the namespace prefix: `/minecraft:give`, `/minecraft:kill`, `/minecraft:recipe`, `/minecraft:xp`, `/minecraft:effect`, `/minecraft:help`.

knownIssues.title: /rest does not skip the night
knownIssues.body: The upstream wiki says "Skip the night (vote)". The implementation is `resetStat(TIME_SINCE_REST)`: it zeroes the insomnia counter that makes phantoms spawn. The game day, weather and sleep vote do not change.
knownIssues.fix: Night — /time night / /day or vanilla sleeping. /rest — anti-phantom only.
